Title: Hounslow Urban Farm, Feltham
Address: Hounslow Urban Farm, Faggs Road, Feltham
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Every day 10:00–17:00 (last entry 16:00), closed Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day
PriceText: Child (2–16) £8, adult £9.50, concession £8.50, family (2+2 or 1+3) £30; tickets valid for a year
Description: Big farm park with goats, pigs, sheep, alpacas, cattle, donkeys, ponies, rheas, owls, small animals and a reptile house (snakes, lizards, tortoises). Free parking
NeedsInfo: Plan your visit page read 2026-10-31 (directories quote older, lower prices). Under-2s price not stated; probably free (child ticket starts at 2) but not confirmed

Title: Odds Farm Park, Wooburn Common
Address: Odds Farm Park, Wooburn Common, High Wycombe, Bucks
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: Daily 10:00–17:30 (last admission 16:30). Closed term-time Tuesdays from 6 October 2026 to 24 February 2027 (open Tuesdays in school holidays). Closed 25–26 December and 1 January; 24 and 31 December close 15:30
PriceText: Adult and child (2–15) £12.95–£20.95 depending on date (save up to £2 online); child 12–23 months £4.95–£5.95; under-1s free
Description: All-inclusive farm park for young families: farm animals, a huge indoor slide and play, shows and seasonal events
Pros: Under-1s free; lots for toddlers; indoor play when it rains
NeedsInfo: Opening times and admission pages read 2026-10-31

Title: Christmas Cracker Santa's Grotto at Odds Farm Park
Address: Odds Farm Park, Wooburn Common, High Wycombe, Bucks
ScheduleText: Selected dates 27 November – 24 December 2026, slots between 8:45 and 18:00
Description: Private visit with Santa through his elves' workshop and Mrs Claus' kitchen, a family photo at the sleigh; each child's ticket includes a full day at the farm park, making a cuddly bear, a free toy and live shows (the A Cappella Penguins)

Title: ZSL Whipsnade Zoo
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
PriceText: Under-3s free. Online before 10:00 on the day, without donation: child (3–15) £19.40–£22.10, adult £27.70–£31.50 (more with the voluntary donation and at the gate)
Description: The UK's largest zoo, set in countryside: elephants, rhinos, bears, Passage through Asia; you can drive between areas
Cons: About an hour's drive from Ealing
